prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A middle-aged man with neatly groomed dark hair and a trimmed beard stands indoors, holding up a smartphone in his right hand. He wears a light beige polo shirt and has a calm, confident expression, making direct eye contact with someone just out of frame. The phone screen he displays is clearly visible, showing a financial or payment app interface with blue and white tones. In the foreground, another person, partially out of focus, holds up a second smartphone, its screen less visible, suggesting a transaction or digital interaction between the two. The background is softly blurred, featuring warm, ambient lighting and hints of ornate decor, creating a cozy, intimate atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by warm browns, beiges, and soft golds, with the cool blue of the phone screen providing contrast. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to draw attention to the main subject and his phone, with a cinematic, slightly over-the-shoulder perspective that enhances the sense of personal connection and modern technology.
